spots.name: Unalaska
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 159 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L38827401.

spots.name: Unalaska: Dutch Harbor
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 142 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L491769.

spots.name: Unangax Cave
spots.tip: A cave entrance. Bring a headlamp and a tripod; light from the opening makes the picture. Check whether it's closed for bats or ice.

spots.name: Glass Beach
spots.tip: Low tide and wet sand give reflections at sunset. Check the tide table and never turn your back on the waves.
